concepts.name: planning_skill
concepts.description: The cognitive skill of selecting a sequence of actions (a plan) to achieve a goal, involving reasoning about states, goals, and operators.

concepts.name: planning_method
concepts.description: An abstract concept for a specific strategy used to solve a planning problem.

concepts.name: partial_order_planning
concepts.description: A planning method (also called nonlinear planning) that avoids goal conflicts (clobbering) by only adding necessary ordering constraints, rather than committing to a full linear sequence early.

concepts.name: hierarchical_task_network_planning
concepts.description: A planning method that decomposes complex, abstract tasks (macro-operators) into a hierarchy of simpler subtasks or primitive operations.

concepts.name: state
concepts.description: A representation of the world at a specific point in time, defined by a set of propositions or variable assignments.

concepts.name: configuration
concepts.description: A specific instance of a state, detailing the properties and relationships of all relevant entities.

concepts.name: plan
concepts.description: A sequence of operators (actions) designed to transition from an initial state to a goal state.

concepts.name: operator
concepts.description: A representation of an action an agent can take, defined by its preconditions and postconditions (effects).

concepts.name: goal_clobbering
concepts.description: A planning conflict where an action taken to achieve one goal negates a precondition required to achieve a different, uncompleted goal.

concepts.name: logic_representation
concepts.description: Abstract concept for formalisms used to represent states and goals.

concepts.name: propositional_logic
concepts.description: A form of logic using propositions (e.g., 'Painted(Ceiling)') and connectives (e.g., 'AND'/'^') to represent states.

concepts.name: example_problem
concepts.description: An abstract concept for a problem used to illustrate a planning skill.

concepts.name: robot_painting_problem
concepts.description: A canonical planning problem where a robot must paint a ladder and a ceiling, involving a goal clobbering conflict.

concepts.name: block_world_problem
concepts.description: A canonical planning problem involving stacking and unstacking blocks to match a goal configuration.

concepts.name: entity
concepts.description: A physical or abstract object in the problem domain.

concepts.name: agent
concepts.description: An entity that performs actions.

concepts.name: robot
concepts.description: The agent in the robot_painting_problem and block_world_problem.

concepts.name: structure
concepts.description: A physical object in the environment.

concepts.name: ladder
concepts.description: A structure that can be climbed or painted.

concepts.name: ceiling
concepts.description: A structure that can be painted.

concepts.name: floor
concepts.description: The ground surface.

concepts.name: table
concepts.description: The surface on which blocks are placed.

concepts.name: block
concepts.description: An object in the Block World problem.

properties.name: on
properties.description: The name of the block or 'Table' it is resting on.

instances.name: bw_initial_config_1
instances.description: Initial state from the example problem: D on B, B on A, A on C, C on Table.

instances.name: bw_goal_config_1
instances.description: Goal state from the example problem: A on B, B on C, C on D, D on Table.

relations.name: on
relations.description: Describes an agent being on a structure.

relations.name: on
relations.description: Describes a block being on another block or on the table.

relations.name: painted
relations.description: A predicate indicating a structure is painted.

relations.name: dry
relations.description: A predicate indicating a structure is dry.

relations.name: isClear
relations.description: A predicate indicating a block has nothing on it.

assertions.name: valid(configuration)
assertions.description: True if a configuration object is non-null and its propositions are well-formed propositional logic statements.
assertions.equivalentTo: configuration != null && configuration.propositions != null && forAll(p in configuration.propositions: isWellFormed(p))

assertions.name: safe(partialPlans)
assertions.description: True if the set of generated partial plans is non-null and each subgoal plan contains at least one step.
assertions.equivalentTo: partialPlans != null && forAll(p in partialPlans: p.steps != null && p.steps.size() > 0)

assertions.name: conflictsFound(conflictReport)
assertions.description: True if the conflict report identifies at least one goal-clobbering conflict between the partial plans.

assertions.name: safe(reorderedPlan)
assertions.description: True if the reordering process produced a conflict-free ordered plan.

assertions.name: safe(execution)
assertions.description: True if the last plan step or operation executed successfully without a precondition violation.

assertions.name: stateMatchesGoal(currentState, goalConfiguration)
assertions.description: True if every proposition in goalConfiguration is satisfied by currentState.

assertions.name: macroTaskSelected
assertions.description: True if a suitable high-level macro-task was found for the current state and remaining goal.

assertions.name: safe(decomposition)
assertions.description: True if the macro-task was successfully decomposed into a non-empty sequence of sub-tasks or primitive operations.

assertions.name: decompositionComplete
assertions.description: True if all steps from the current macro-task decomposition have been executed.

assertions.name: blockToMoveFound
assertions.description: True if there exists a clear block in the current configuration that is not on the table.
assertions.equivalentTo: exists(b in currentConfig.blocks: isClear(b) && NOT on(b, Table))

assertions.name: nextBlockFound
assertions.description: True if there is a next block in goalOrder that has not yet been placed on its target block.
assertions.equivalentTo: exists(b in goalOrder: NOT on(b, targetOf(b, goalOrder)))

assertions.name: safe(move)
assertions.description: True if a Move Block operation (to table or to block) completed successfully.

assertions.name: achieves(finalPlan, goalConfiguration)
assertions.description: True if executing finalPlan from the given initial configuration results in a state that satisfies goalConfiguration.

assertions.name: preconditionsMet(planStep, currentState)
assertions.description: True if every precondition of the given operator is satisfied in the current state.
